title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalamu Alaikum, Dear Brother, My name is Naseer and I am working in Dubai. I am sending this question on behalf of my friend. My friend name is Shakeel Ahmed. He has blessed with 3 son as of now. The names of his first two sons are 1). Faizan Muhammed & 2). Muhammed Farhaan. His third son name is Muhammed Subhan and his age is 2 years. The question is that, is it okay to put name as Muhammed Subhan for any muslim child? Recently he was advised by some people to change this name. Because it is not good to naming for a muslim child as Muhammed Subhan. We would like to know the answer for this uestion from your end. PLease try to give the reply as soon as possible. Thanks in advance. 1684 views Q. Mohammed Habeebuddin Majid because Majid is one among Allah's name and Abdul is not present in this name 2308 views Q. can we name a muslim boy 'Abu sufian'? 2589 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 44366 Country: India Title: Names for children to be born Question: My wife is now pregnant; I planned to keep the Male baby as Mohammad Abdul Razaq and for the baby girl as Ayesha Zainab. Please suggest me in this regard whether these names can be kept or not. Answer ID: 44366 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 503/503/M=1434) Bo the proposed names are alright. May Allah bestow you pious offspring! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
